title: 代名詞
point: 代名詞題先看空格的位置。在動詞前面當主詞、在動詞或介系詞後面當受詞、在名詞前面當所有格，位置一決定，格就跟著決定。
formula: 主詞 + 動詞 + 所有格（their / its / his / her）+ 名詞

table.rule: 放在動詞前面當主詞：主格 I / we / they / he / she / it
放在動詞後面當受詞：受格 me / us / them / him / her

table.en: several of them / a message for her
table.zh: 他們當中幾位、給她的留言
table.rule: 介系詞（of / for / with / to）後面一律用受格

table.en: their reports / its policy / his office
table.zh: 他們的報告、它的政策、他的辦公室
table.rule: 後面緊接名詞：所有格 my / our / their / his / her / its
後面不接名詞，自己就等於「所有格 + 名詞」：所有格代名詞 mine / ours / theirs / hers

table.en: The staff set up the booth themselves.
table.rule: 主詞自己做，或強調親自：反身代名詞 -self / -selves，指回同一個主詞

table.en: its warranty / it's (= it is) ready
table.rule: its 是所有格，後面接名詞；it's 是 it is 的縮寫，後面接形容詞或動詞

examples: The new interns completed their safety training on the first day.
The company updated its travel policy after the merger.
story: The purchasing team reviewed its supplier list last week.
Mr. Tanaka sent his recommendations to the finance director.
Five suppliers had raised their prices, so several of them were removed from the list.
The remaining suppliers will send their revised quotes by Friday.

drills.prompt: Did Mr. Tanaka send his recommendations to the finance director?
drills.fix: his recommendations 是所有格 + 名詞，指 Mr. Tanaka 自己的建議，他寄給了財務主管。

drills.prompt: Were some of the suppliers that raised prices removed?
drills.fix: several of them 的 them 指漲價的供應商，介系詞 of 後面用受格。

drills.prompt: The warehouse staff updated ___ inventory records.
drills.fix: 空格後面緊接名詞 inventory records，要用所有格 their。
